1580-3025-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-3025-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3755-4770-6090-6968.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3363-5278.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Return The One Ring to your hand using Obelisk of Undoing.
Repeat each turn.

500-2523-3129-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bard and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Bard token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Bards dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Bard that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Bards you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

206-215-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
206-215-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
206-215-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

4885-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4885-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4885-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2498-6980-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2498-6980-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred and Stark's Ingenuity trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Stark's Ingenuity trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
2498-6980-7737.notes: With the additional Stark's Ingenuity trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

628-5147-7189.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

876-3497-7070.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
876-3497-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

620-3532-4908-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

2103-2573-4423-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-2573-4423-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

81-1636-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-1636-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin plus one due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

2525-4681-6797.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3194-3582-6798.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

1066-1878-2634-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1066-1878-2634-5195.description:
Cast Borne Upon a Wind by paying {1}{U}, allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.
1066-1878-2634-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

341-1020-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4452-5116.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-4452-5116.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
3767-3918-4452-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

880-3585-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2783-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3259-4359-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-4359-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

913-1641-2034-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
913-1641-2034-4192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1926-4963-5231.notablePrerequisites:
"Bear" chosen with Species Specialist.
You have a way to draw a card.
1926-4963-5231.description:
Activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Draw a card, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token instead.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Bear token, adding {R}.When the Bear dies, Species Specialist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, replacing your next card draw with creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Resolve the Species Specialist trigger, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

337-643-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-643-4222-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

2167-3234-3861-4050-4548.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands, plus three in any combination of additional mana-producing lands and/or legendary creatures.
2167-3234-3861-4050-4548.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each remaining mana-producing land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {G}.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, causing you to mill three cards and return World Shaper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control additional mana-producing lands beyond what is required, this combo nets infinite colored mana if one of those lands produces {B} or {G}, or infinite mana lands you control can produce otherwise.

1766-3325-4067.notablePrerequisites: Xantcha on the battlefield under an opponent's control.
1766-3325-4067.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Xantcha by paying {3}, causing its controller to lose 2 life and you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

457-1170-1306-4331.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Urza.
Urza enters the battlefield, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's second ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Mana Crypt resolves.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may get infinite blue mana by tapping Mana Crypt with Urza's ability, and you may activate Urza's last ability any number of times.

1808-3000-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

3857-3859-4191.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other black permanent.
3857-3859-4191.description:
Cast Parasitic Strix by paying {0}.
Parasitic Strix enters the battlefield, causing target player to lose 2 life and gaining you 2 life.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {0}.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, returning Parasitic Strix to your hand.
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
